|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023) (PDF created 17 June 2023), cut unchanged from page 2. The current text is [[Power Of The Hutt (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

[Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-851523c">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/851523cf87900914eb80b26404f2983523de119f swccg-card-json commit 851523c] “all of V21 DS” (17 June 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [[Media:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition]] (eight pages; June 2023 printed footer; [[:File:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|source details]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 2, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploy on table. While Nal Hutta on table and your alien at Audience Chamber, [Reflections III] Leia's game text is canceled and, once during opponent's turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per turn, may ▼ Hutt Influence, Bib, or a barge. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Power Of The Hutt”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]] (repository revision dated 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Power Of The Hutt]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The June 2023 sheet has creation metadata dated 17 June; this exact printed edition is independently documented by 26 June 2023. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Power Of The Hutt (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (28 June 2023, 11 days after release)<ref name="ht-bd233df">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/bd233dff6f6002545b433d4042a3cdb753f314b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Dark/large/powerofthehutt.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Dark/large/powerofthehutt.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/bd233dff6f6002545b433d4042a3cdb753f314b1 bd233df] “Power Of The Hutt V errata”, 28 June 2023, 11 days after release.</ref> prints: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may ▼ Hutt Influence, Bib, or a barge. While Nal Hutta on table and your alien at Audience Chamber, [Reflections III] Leia may not cancel Force drains (or reduce your total ability) and, once during opponent’s turn, you may activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The ▼ sentence (“Once per turn, may ▼ Hutt Influence, Bib, or a barge.”) moved to the front; “[Reflections III] Leia’s game text is canceled” became “[Reflections III] Leia may not cancel Force drains (or reduce your total ability)”; “may activate 1 Force” became “you may activate 1 Force”. The PC card data (swccg-card-json) and the PC card list never took this change: they still give the original wording. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.

A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
